titles_romaji.title: Toning Down the Gangster Male Lead

description:
To adjust the intensity of the gangster male lead on the verge of going dark!

Alone and isolated, Baek Yi-Hae finds herself possessed by a depraved 19+ romance game.

 *“No way... I didn't get targeted by the gangster male lead, did I?!”*

Baek Yi-Hae unexpectedly moves into the Seo family, a notorious gangster clan. To protect her peaceful, safe life as a supporting character, she must prevent baby gangster Seo Do-Gyeom from going dark and secure a happy ending. Amidst the intersection of school life, romance, and the game's threatening rules, the relationship between Baek Yi-Hae and Seo Do-Gyeom grows increasingly complex...!

*“Why are you only kind to me?”*

A sweet yet deadly survival romance where you can never let your guard down!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
